58	def _make_parcels(config: dict, grid):
59	    from landlab.components import NetworkSedimentTransporter
60	    from landlab.data_record import DataRecord
61	
62	    pulses = {pulse["pulse_id"]: pulse for pulse in config["physical_pulses"]}
63	    entries = config["sediment_record"]
64	    n_items = len(entries)
65	    shape = (n_items, 1)
66	    links = np.asarray([pulses[e["pulse_id"]]["starting_link"] for e in entries])
67	    locations = np.asarray(
68	        [pulses[e["pulse_id"]]["normalized_location"] for e in entries]
69	    )
70	    volumes = np.asarray([e["volume_m3"] for e in entries], dtype=float)
71	    material = config["material"]
72	
73	    return DataRecord(
74	        grid,
75	        items={"grid_element": "link", "element_id": links.reshape(shape)},
76	        time=[0.0],
77	        data_vars={
78	            "starting_link": (["item_id"], links.copy()),
79	            "abrasion_rate": (
80	                ["item_id"],
81	                np.full(n_items, material["abrasion_rate_m_inverse"]),
82	            ),
83	            "density": (
84	                ["item_id"],
85	                np.full(n_items, material["sediment_density_kg_m3"]),
86	            ),
87	            "time_arrival_in_link": (["item_id", "time"], np.zeros(shape)),
88	            "active_layer": (["item_id", "time"], np.ones(shape)),
89	            "location_in_link": (["item_id", "time"], locations.reshape(shape)),
90	            "D": (["item_id", "time"], np.full(shape, material["grain_diameter_m"])),
91	            "volume": (["item_id", "time"], volumes.reshape(shape)),
92	            "pulse_id": (["item_id"], np.asarray([e["pulse_id"] for e in entries])),
93	        },
94	        dummy_elements={"link": [NetworkSedimentTransporter.OUT_OF_NETWORK]},

98	def run_experiment(config: dict) -> PublicObservation:
99	    load_candidate_landlab()
100	    from landlab.components import FlowDirectorSteepest, NetworkSedimentTransporter
101	    from landlab.grid.network import NetworkModelGrid
102	
103	    network = config["network"]
104	    grid = NetworkModelGrid(
105	        (network["y_of_node_m"], network["x_of_node_m"]),
106	        network["nodes_at_link"],
107	    )
108	    grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"] = network["topographic_elevation_m"]
109	    grid.at_node["bedrock__elevation"] = network["bedrock_elevation_m"]
110	    grid.at_link["reach_length"] = network["reach_length_m"]
111	    grid.at_link["channel_width"] = network["channel_width_m"]
112	    grid.at_link["flow_depth"] = network["flow_depth_m"]
113	
114	    flow_director = FlowDirectorSteepest(grid)
115	    flow_director.run_one_step()
116	    parcels = _make_parcels(config, grid)
117	    experiment = config["experiment"]
118	    model = NetworkSedimentTransporter(
119	        grid,
120	        parcels,
121	        flow_director,
122	        bed_porosity=experiment["bed_porosity"],
123	        g=experiment["gravity_m_s2"],
124	        fluid_density=experiment["fluid_density_kg_m3"],
125	        transport_method="WilcockCrowe",
126	    )
127	
128	    for _ in range(experiment["steps"]):
129	        model.run_one_step(experiment["time_step_s"])
130	
131	    links = np.asarray(parcels.dataset.element_id.values[:, -1], dtype=float)
132	    locations = np.asarray(parcels.dataset.location_in_link.values[:, -1], dtype=float)
133	    volumes = np.asarray(parcels.dataset.volume.values[:, -1], dtype=float)
134	    pulse_ids = np.asarray(parcels.dataset.pulse_id.values)
135	    routed_distance = _distance_from_outlet(grid, links, locations)
136	
137	    path_summary: dict[str, float] = {}
138	    for pulse_id in sorted(set(str(value) for value in pulse_ids.tolist())):
139	        selected = pulse_ids == pulse_id
140	        on_network = selected & np.isfinite(routed_distance)
141	        path_summary[pulse_id] = (
142	            float(np.average(routed_distance[on_network], weights=volumes[on_network]))
143	            if np.any(on_network)
144	            else 0.0
145	        )
146	
147	    state_totals = np.zeros(grid.number_of_links, dtype=float)
148	    for link in range(grid.number_of_links):
149	        state_totals[link] = float(np.sum(volumes[links == link]))
150	    boundary_total = float(np.sum(volumes[links < 0]))
151	    surface = np.asarray(grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"], dtype=float)
152	    numeric = np.concatenate(
153	        (
154	            np.asarray(list(path_summary.values()), dtype=float),
155	            state_totals,
156	            np.asarray([boundary_total], dtype=float),
157	            surface,
158	        )
159	    )
160	    on_network = (links >= 0) & np.isfinite(routed_distance)
161	    distance_values = routed_distance[on_network]
162	    return PublicObservation(
163	        finite=bool(np.all(np.isfinite(numeric))),
164	        pulse_count=len(path_summary),
165	        on_network_count=int(np.count_nonzero(on_network)),
166	        state_count=int(state_totals.size),
167	        boundary_volume=boundary_total,
168	        distance_min=(float(np.min(distance_values)) if distance_values.size else None),
169	        distance_max=(float(np.max(distance_values)) if distance_values.size else None),
170	    )

19	def _install_aggregator_compatibility_module() -> None:
20	    """Provide the base commit's new Cython API without changing science code."""
21	    module = types.ModuleType("landlab.data_record._aggregators")
22	
23	    def aggregate_items_as_count(out, element_of_item):
24	        out[:] = 0
25	        for element in np.asarray(element_of_item, dtype=int):
26	            if element >= 0:
27	                out[element] += 1
28	
29	    def aggregate_items_as_sum(out, element_of_item, value_of_item):
30	        out[:] = 0
31	        for element, value in zip(element_of_item, value_of_item, strict=True):
32	            if element >= 0:
33	                out[int(element)] += value
34	
35	    def aggregate_items_as_mean(out, element_of_item, value_of_item, weight_of_item):
36	        out[:] = 0.0
37	        total_weight = np.zeros(len(out), dtype=float)
38	        for element, value, weight in zip(
39	            element_of_item, value_of_item, weight_of_item, strict=True
40	        ):
41	            if element >= 0:
42	                out[int(element)] += value * weight
43	                total_weight[int(element)] += weight
44	        selected = total_weight > 0.0
45	        out[selected] /= total_weight[selected]
46	
47	    def aggregate_items_as_gmean(
48	        out, element_of_item, value_of_item, weight_of_item, where
49	    ):
50	        total_weight = np.zeros(len(out), dtype=float)
51	        weighted_log = np.zeros(len(out), dtype=float)
52	        for element, value, weight, include in zip(
53	            element_of_item, value_of_item, weight_of_item, where, strict=True
54	        ):
55	            if include and element >= 0:
56	                weighted_log[int(element)] += weight * np.log(value)
57	                total_weight[int(element)] += weight
58	        selected = total_weight > 0.0
59	        out[selected] = np.exp(weighted_log[selected] / total_weight[selected])
60	
61	    module.aggregate_items_as_count = aggregate_items_as_count
62	    module.aggregate_items_as_sum = aggregate_items_as_sum
63	    module.aggregate_items_as_mean = aggregate_items_as_mean
64	    module.aggregate_items_as_gmean = aggregate_items_as_gmean
65	    sys.modules[module.__name__] = module

68	def _copy_wheel_binary_support(wheel_package: Path) -> None:
69	    """Preserve the wheel layout expected by copied extension RPATHs."""
70	    wheel_libraries = wheel_package.parent / "landlab.libs"
71	    if wheel_libraries.is_dir():
72	        destination = OVERLAY_ROOT.parent / wheel_libraries.name
73	        if destination.exists():
74	            shutil.rmtree(destination)

78	def load_candidate_landlab():
79	    """Load candidate Python sources while reusing wheel-provided extensions."""
80	    wheel_package = Path(
81	        importlib.metadata.distribution("landlab").locate_file("landlab")
82	    ).resolve()
83	    if OVERLAY_ROOT.exists():
84	        shutil.rmtree(OVERLAY_ROOT)
85	    shutil.copytree(SOURCE_PACKAGE, OVERLAY_ROOT)
86	    _copy_wheel_binary_support(wheel_package)
87	    for suffix in importlib.machinery.EXTENSION_SUFFIXES:
88	        for extension in wheel_package.rglob(f"*{suffix}"):
89	            relative = extension.relative_to(wheel_package)
90	            if (
91	                len(relative.parts) >= 2
92	                and relative.parts[0] == "data_record"
93	                and relative.name.startswith("_aggregators.")
94	            ):
95	                continue
96	            target = OVERLAY_ROOT / relative
97	            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
98	            shutil.copy2(extension, target)
99	    for module_name in list(sys.modules):
100	        if module_name == "landlab" or module_name.startswith("landlab."):
101	            del sys.modules[module_name]
102	    _install_aggregator_compatibility_module()
103	
104	    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
105	        "landlab",
106	        OVERLAY_ROOT / "__init__.py",
107	        submodule_search_locations=[str(OVERLAY_ROOT), str(wheel_package)],
108	    )
109	    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
110	        raise RuntimeError("unable to create candidate Landlab import specification")
111	
112	    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
113	    module.__path__ = [str(OVERLAY_ROOT), str(wheel_package)]
114	    sys.modules["landlab"] = module
115	    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
116	
117	    from landlab.components import NetworkSedimentTransporter
118	
119	    implementation = Path(
120	        sys.modules[NetworkSedimentTransporter.__module__].__file__ or ""
121	    ).resolve()
122	    if OVERLAY_ROOT not in implementation.parents:
123	        raise RuntimeError("scientific component was not loaded from candidate source")
124	    return module

"""Run the fixture NST experiment with either candidate source or wheel."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

TASK_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CASE = TASK_ROOT / "fixtures" / "public_river_network.json"

mode = sys.argv[1]  # "cand" or "wheel"
if mode == "cand":
    sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT))
    from workflow.load_candidate import load_candidate_landlab

    load_candidate_landlab()
    import landlab

    assert ".build" in (landlab.__file__ or "")

from landlab.components import FlowDirectorSteepest, NetworkSedimentTransporter
from landlab.data_record import DataRecord
from landlab.grid.network import NetworkModelGrid

config = json.loads(CASE.read_text())
network = config["network"]
grid = NetworkModelGrid(
    (network["y_of_node_m"], network["x_of_node_m"]),
    network["nodes_at_link"],
)
grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"] = network["topographic_elevation_m"]
grid.at_node["bedrock__elevation"] = network["bedrock_elevation_m"]
grid.at_link["reach_length"] = network["reach_length_m"]
grid.at_link["channel_width"] = network["channel_width_m"]
grid.at_link["flow_depth"] = network["flow_depth_m"]

fd = FlowDirectorSteepest(grid)
fd.run_one_step()

pulses = {p["pulse_id"]: p for p in config["physical_pulses"]}
entries = config["sediment_record"]
n_items = len(entries)
links = np.asarray([pulses[e["pulse_id"]]["starting_link"] for e in entries])
locations = np.asarray([pulses[e["pulse_id"]]["normalized_location"] for e in entries])
volumes = np.asarray([e["volume_m3"] for e in entries], dtype=float)
material = config["material"]

parcels = DataRecord(
    grid,
    items={"grid_element": "link", "element_id": links.reshape((n_items, 1))},
    time=[0.0],
    data_vars={
        "starting_link": (["item_id"], links.copy()),
        "abrasion_rate": (["item_id"], np.full(n_items, material["abrasion_rate_m_inverse"])),
        "density": (["item_id"], np.full(n_items, material["sediment_density_kg_m3"])),
        "time_arrival_in_link": (["item_id", "time"], np.zeros((n_items, 1))),
        "active_layer": (["item_id", "time"], np.ones((n_items, 1))),
        "location_in_link": (["item_id", "time"], locations.reshape((n_items, 1))),
        "D": (["item_id", "time"], np.full((n_items, 1), material["grain_diameter_m"])),
        "volume": (["item_id", "time"], volumes.reshape((n_items, 1))),
        "pulse_id": (["item_id"], np.asarray([e["pulse_id"] for e in entries])),
    },
    dummy_elements={"link": [NetworkSedimentTransporter.OUT_OF_NETWORK]},
)

experiment = config["experiment"]
model = NetworkSedimentTransporter(
    grid,
    parcels,
    fd,
    bed_porosity=experiment["bed_porosity"],
    g=experiment["gravity_m_s2"],
    fluid_density=experiment["fluid_density_kg_m3"],
    transport_method="WilcockCrowe",
)

hist = {}
for var in ["element_id", "location_in_link", "volume", "D", "active_layer", "time_arrival_in_link"]:
    hist[var] = [np.asarray(parcels.dataset[var].values).copy()]

for _ in range(experiment["steps"]):
    model.run_one_step(experiment["time_step_s"])
    for var in hist:
        hist[var].append(np.asarray(parcels.dataset[var].values).copy())

out = {
    "times": [float(t) for t in parcels.dataset.time.values],
    "hist": {k: np.concatenate([a.T if a.ndim == 3 else a for a in v], axis=0) for k, v in hist.items()},
    "final_element_id": np.asarray(parcels.dataset.element_id.values[:, -1]),
    "final_location": np.asarray(parcels.dataset.location_in_link.values[:, -1]),
    "final_volume": np.asarray(parcels.dataset.volume.values[:, -1]),
    "surface": np.asarray(grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"]),
    "bedrock": np.asarray(grid.at_node["bedrock__elevation"]),
}
np.savez_compressed(TASK_ROOT / "outputs" / f"traj_{mode}.npz", **{k if k != "hist" else "x": v for k, v in out.items() if k != "hist"})
for k, v in hist.items():
    arr = np.stack([np.squeeze(a, axis=-1) if a.ndim == 3 and a.shape[-1] == 1 else a for a in [None if not v else v[0]]] or [], axis=0) if False else None
# save histories with time-major stacking for easy diff
with open(TASK_ROOT / "outputs" / f"hist_{mode}.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(
        {
            "times": out["times"],
            "hist": {k: [np.asarray(a).tolist() for a in v] for k, v in hist.items()},
            "surface": out["surface"].tolist(),
        },
        f,
    )
print(f"{mode} done; times={out['times']}")

"""Run a scenario config with candidate source or wheel; dump full history."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

TASK_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

mode = sys.argv[1]  # "cand" or "wheel"
scenario_path = Path(sys.argv[2])
if mode == "cand":
    sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT))
    from workflow.load_candidate import load_candidate_landlab

    load_candidate_landlab()
    import landlab

    assert ".build" in (landlab.__file__ or "")

from landlab.components import FlowDirectorSteepest, NetworkSedimentTransporter
from landlab.data_record import DataRecord
from landlab.grid.network import NetworkModelGrid

config = json.loads(scenario_path.read_text())
network = config["network"]
grid = NetworkModelGrid(
    (network["y_of_node_m"], network["x_of_node_m"]),
    network["nodes_at_link"],
)
grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"] = network["topographic_elevation_m"]
grid.at_node["bedrock__elevation"] = network["bedrock_elevation_m"]
grid.at_link["reach_length"] = network["reach_length_m"]
grid.at_link["channel_width"] = network["channel_width_m"]
grid.at_link["flow_depth"] = network["flow_depth_m"]

fd = FlowDirectorSteepest(grid)
fd.run_one_step()

entries = config["sediment_record"]
n_items = len(entries)
links = np.asarray([e["link"] for e in entries])
locations = np.asarray([e["location"] for e in entries])
volumes = np.asarray([e["volume_m3"] for e in entries], dtype=float)
material = config["material"]
D_each = np.asarray(e.get("D", material["grain_diameter_m"]) for e in entries)
rho_each = np.asarray(e.get("density", material["sediment_density_kg_m3"]) for e in entries)
abr_each = np.asarray(e.get("abrasion_rate", material["abrasion_rate_m_inverse"]) for e in entries)

parcels = DataRecord(
    grid,
    items={"grid_element": "link", "element_id": links.reshape((n_items, 1))},
    time=[0.0],
    data_vars={
        "starting_link": (["item_id"], links.copy()),
        "abrasion_rate": (["item_id"], abr_each),
        "density": (["item_id"], rho_each),
        "time_arrival_in_link": (["item_id", "time"], np.zeros((n_items, 1))),
        "active_layer": (["item_id", "time"], np.ones((n_items, 1))),
        "location_in_link": (["item_id", "time"], locations.reshape((n_items, 1))),
        "D": (["item_id", "time"], D_each.reshape((n_items, 1))),
        "volume": (["item_id", "time"], volumes.reshape((n_items, 1))),
    },
    dummy_elements={"link": [NetworkSedimentTransporter.OUT_OF_NETWORK]},
)

experiment = config["experiment"]
model = NetworkSedimentTransporter(
    grid,
    parcels,
    fd,
    bed_porosity=experiment["bed_porosity"],
    g=experiment["gravity_m_s2"],
    fluid_density=experiment["fluid_density_kg_m3"],
    transport_method=config.get("transport_method", "WilcockCrowe"),
    **config.get("extra_model_kwargs", {}),
)

VARS = ["element_id", "location_in_link", "volume", "D", "active_layer", "time_arrival_in_link"]
HIST = {var: [np.asarray(parcels.dataset[var].values).copy()] for var in VARS}

for _ in range(experiment["steps"]):
    model.run_one_step(experiment["time_step_s"])
    for var in VARS:
        HIST[var].append(np.asarray(parcels.dataset[var].values).copy())

result = {
    "times": [float(t) for t in parcels.dataset.time.values],
    "hist": {k: [np.asarray(a).tolist() for a in v] for k, v in HIST.items()},
    "surface": np.asarray(grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"]).tolist(),
    "link_fields": {name: np.asarray(grid.at_link[name]).tolist() for name in sorted(grid.at_link.keys())},
}
out_path = TASK_ROOT / "outputs" / f"scen_{scenario_path.stem}_{mode}.json"
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(result))
print(out_path)

## 2.11.0 (2026-04-05)
### 🍰 New Features
* Added a new module, `landlab.utils.geometry.planar`, for calculating path lengths. [#2186](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2186)
* Added a `nodata_value` keyword to `esri_ascii.dump`, allowing users to specify a custom nodata value when exporting grid data to ESRI ASCII format. [#2204](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2204)
* Added support for Python 3.14. [#2278](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2278)
* Added a `perimeter_links` parameter to the `__init__()` method of the `VoronoiDelaunayGrid` class to allow removal of extraneous links and cells when creating a grid. [#2296](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2296)
* Added a new utility, `validate_array`, to ensure *NumPy* arrays meet requirements for dtype, shape, writeability, and memory contiguity. [#2308](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2308)
* Added a raster-specific optimized Cython implementation of `map_max_of_link_nodes_to_link` for improved performance. [#2309](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2309)
* Added a Cython implementation of `weighted_mean_of_parallel_links` to optimize calculations in the OverlandFlow component. [#2310](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2310)
* Added new validators to check whether values fall within a specified range. [#2322](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2322)
* Added a new validator, `require_one_of`, to ensure values are contained within a set of allowed values. [#2332](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2332)
* Added a `smoothed_threshold` parameter to the `ErosionDeposition` and `SharedStreamPower` components. [#2339](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2339)
### 🛠️ Bug Fixes
* Fixed an issue where the lower-left corner location was incorrectly written by `esri_ascii.dump`. [#2207](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2207)
* Removed the broken `default_fixed_links` keyword parameter from the `OverlandFlow` component. [#2313](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/issues/2313)

"""Randomized differential fuzz: candidate source vs installed wheel for NST."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

TASK_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

mode = sys.argv[1]          # "cand" | "wheel"
seed = int(sys.argv[2])
count = int(sys.argv[3])    # number of scenarios

if mode == "cand":
    sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT))
    from workflow.load_candidate import load_candidate_landlab

    load_candidate_landlab()
    import landlab

    assert ".build" in (landlab.__file__ or "")

from landlab.components import FlowDirectorSteepest, NetworkSedimentTransporter
from landlab.data_record import DataRecord
from landlab.grid.network import NetworkModelGrid


def gen_network(rng):
    # random directed tree: N nodes; node k>0 connects to a random earlier node
    n_nodes = int(rng.integers(5, 13))
    y = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n_nodes)
    x = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n_nodes)
    # elevation decreasing with "generation": make node 0 the outlet
    gen = np.zeros(n_nodes, dtype=int)
    parents = np.full(n_nodes, -1, dtype=int)
    nodes_at_link = []
    for k in range(1, n_nodes):
        p = int(rng.integers(0, k))
        nodes_at_link.append([k, p])  # arbitrary ordering; flow dir decides
        parents[k] = p
        gen[k] = gen[p] + 1
    base = rng.uniform(0, 20)
    step = rng.uniform(0.2, 5.0)
    topo = base + (gen.max() - gen) * step + rng.uniform(0, 0.3, n_nodes)
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        bedrock = topo.copy()
    else:
        bedrock = topo - rng.uniform(0, 0.5, n_nodes)  # initial alluvium
    n_links = len(nodes_at_link)
    return {
        "y": y.tolist(),
        "x": x.tolist(),
        "nodes_at_link": nodes_at_link,
        "topo": topo.tolist(),
        "bedrock": bedrock.tolist(),
        "reach": np.abs(rng.normal(150, 40, n_links)).clip(10).tolist(),
        "width": np.abs(rng.normal(12, 5, n_links)).clip(1).tolist(),
        "depth": np.abs(rng.normal(0.6, 0.3, n_links)).clip(0.02).tolist(),
    }


def gen_parcels(rng, n_links):
    n_items = int(rng.integers(1, 15))
    links = rng.integers(0, n_links, n_items)
    return {
        "links": links,
        "loc": rng.uniform(0, 1, n_items),
        "vol": np.abs(rng.normal(0.4, 0.25, n_items)).clip(0.02),
        "D": rng.choice([0.0015, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15], n_items) * rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5, n_items),
        "rho": rng.uniform(1400, 2650, n_items),
        "abr": rng.uniform(0, 2e-4, n_items),
    }


def run_one(net, parcels, experiment):
    grid = NetworkModelGrid((net["y"], net["x"]), net["nodes_at_link"])
    grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"] = net["topo"]
    grid.at_node["bedrock__elevation"] = net["bedrock"]
    grid.at_link["reach_length"] = net["reach"]
    grid.at_link["channel_width"] = net["width"]
    grid.at_link["flow_depth"] = net["depth"]

    fd = FlowDirectorSteepest(grid)
    fd.run_one_step()

    n_items = len(parcels["links"])

"""Refactored shared fuzz helpers: no side effects on import."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from landlab.components import FlowDirectorSteepest, NetworkSedimentTransporter
from landlab.data_record import DataRecord
from landlab.grid.network import NetworkModelGrid


def gen_network(rng):
    n_nodes = int(rng.integers(5, 13))
    y = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n_nodes)
    x = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n_nodes)
    gen = np.zeros(n_nodes, dtype=int)
    nodes_at_link = []
    for k in range(1, n_nodes):
        p = int(rng.integers(0, k))
        nodes_at_link.append([k, p])
        gen[k] = gen[p] + 1
    base = rng.uniform(0, 20)
    step = rng.uniform(0.2, 5.0)
    topo = base + (gen.max() - gen) * step + rng.uniform(0, 0.3, n_nodes)
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        bedrock = topo.copy()
    else:
        bedrock = topo - rng.uniform(0, 0.5, n_nodes)
    n_links = len(nodes_at_link)
    return {
        "y": y.tolist(),
        "x": x.tolist(),
        "nodes_at_link": nodes_at_link,
        "topo": topo.tolist(),
        "bedrock": bedrock.tolist(),
        "reach": np.abs(rng.normal(150, 40, n_links)).clip(10).tolist(),
        "width": np.abs(rng.normal(12, 5, n_links)).clip(1).tolist(),
        "depth": np.abs(rng.normal(0.6, 0.3, n_links)).clip(0.02).tolist(),
    }


def gen_parcels(rng, n_links):
    n_items = int(rng.integers(1, 15))
    return {
        "links": rng.integers(0, n_links, n_items),
        "loc": rng.uniform(0, 1, n_items),
        "vol": np.abs(rng.normal(0.4, 0.25, n_items)).clip(0.02),
        "D": rng.choice([0.0015, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15], n_items) * rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5, n_items),
        "rho": rng.uniform(1400, 2650, n_items),
        "abr": rng.uniform(0, 2e-4, n_items),
    }


def gen_experiment(rng):
    return {
        "dt": float(rng.integers(10, 900)),
        "steps": int(rng.integers(2, 25)),
        "porosity": float(rng.uniform(0.1, 0.5)),
        "rhof": float(rng.uniform(900, 1100)),
        "alm": str(rng.choice(["WongParker", "GrainSizeDependent", "Constant10cm"])),
        "aldm": int(rng.integers(1, 5)),
        "slope_threshold": float(rng.uniform(1e-6, 1e-2)),
        "k_transp_dep_abr": (None if rng.random() < 0.7 else float(rng.uniform(1, 45))),
    }


def run_one(net, parcels, experiment):
    grid = NetworkModelGrid((net["y"], net["x"]), net["nodes_at_link"])
    grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"] = net["topo"]
    grid.at_node["bedrock__elevation"] = net["bedrock"]
    grid.at_link["reach_length"] = net["reach"]
    grid.at_link["channel_width"] = net["width"]
    grid.at_link["flow_depth"] = net["depth"]

    fd = FlowDirectorSteepest(grid)
    fd.run_one_step()

    n_items = len(parcels["links"])
    dr = DataRecord(
        grid,
        items={"grid_element": "link", "element_id": parcels["links"].reshape((n_items, 1))},
        time=[0.0],
        data_vars={
            "starting_link": (["item_id"], parcels["links"].copy()),
            "abrasion_rate": (["item_id"], parcels["abr"]),
            "density": (["item_id"], parcels["rho"]),
            "time_arrival_in_link": (["item_id", "time"], np.zeros((n_items, 1))),
            "active_layer": (["item_id", "time"], np.ones((n_items, 1))),
            "location_in_link": (["item_id", "time"], parcels["loc"].reshape((n_items, 1))),
            "D": (["item_id", "time"], parcels["D"].reshape((n_items, 1))),
            "volume": (["item_id", "time"], parcels["vol"].reshape((n_items, 1))),
        },
        dummy_elements={"link": [NetworkSedimentTransporter.OUT_OF_NETWORK]},
    )
    kwargs = {}
    if experiment.get("k_transp_dep_abr") is not None:
        kwargs["k_transp_dep_abr"] = experiment["k_transp_dep_abr"]
    model = NetworkSedimentTransporter(
        grid,
        dr,
        fd,
        bed_porosity=experiment["porosity"],
        g=9.81,
        fluid_density=experiment["rhof"],
        transport_method="WilcockCrowe",
        active_layer_method=experiment["alm"],
        active_layer_d_multiplier=experiment["aldm"],
        slope_threshold=experiment["slope_threshold"],
        **kwargs,
    )
    VARS = ["element_id", "location_in_link", "volume", "D", "active_layer", "time_arrival_in_link"]
    hist = {v: [] for v in VARS}
    for v in VARS:
        hist[v].append(np.asarray(dr.dataset[v].values).copy())
        hist[v].append(np.asarray(dr.dataset[v].values).copy())
    crashed = None
    for _ in range(experiment["steps"]):
        try:
            model.run_one_step(experiment["dt"])
        except RuntimeError as exc:
            crashed = str(exc)
            break
        for v in VARS:
            hist[v].append(np.asarray(dr.dataset[v].values).copy())
    out = {v: np.array(hist[v][1:]).tolist() for v in VARS}
    out["surface"] = np.asarray(grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"]).tolist()
    out["link_fields"] = {k: np.asarray(grid.at_link[k]).tolist() for k in sorted(grid.at_link.keys())}
    out["crashed"] = crashed
    return out


def scrub(net, parcels, experiment):
    net_js = {k: (v if isinstance(v, list) else [float(u) for u in v]) for k, v in net.items()}
    p_js = {k: (v.tolist() if hasattr(v, "tolist") else v) for k, v in parcels.items()}
    return {"net": net_js, "parcels": p_js, "experiment": experiment}

  python fuzz_driver.py cand|wheel <seed> <count> <start> <n>
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

TASK_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

mode = sys.argv[1]
seed = int(sys.argv[2])
count = int(sys.argv[3])

cfg_path = TASK_ROOT / "outputs" / "fuzz" / f"configs_{seed}_{count}.json"
cfg_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

if mode == "gen":
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT / "outputs"))
    # gen functions only need numpy, but import module for reuse
    import fuzz_nst_ref as F

    # avoid importing landlab at generation time: replicate draws locally
    configs = []
    for _ in range(count):
        # draw using same call order as fuzz_nst_ref functions to keep deterministic
        n_nodes = int(rng.integers(5, 13))
        y = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n_nodes)
        x = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n_nodes)
        gen = np.zeros(n_nodes, dtype=int)
        nodes_at_link = []
        for k in range(1, n_nodes):
            p = int(rng.integers(0, k))
            nodes_at_link.append([k, p])
            gen[k] = gen[p] + 1
        base = rng.uniform(0, 20)
        step = rng.uniform(0.2, 5.0)
        topo = base + (gen.max() - gen) * step + rng.uniform(0, 0.3, n_nodes)
        use_alluvium = rng.random() < 0.5
        if use_alluvium:
            bedrock = topo - rng.uniform(0, 0.5, n_nodes)
        else:
            bedrock = topo.copy()
        n_links = len(nodes_at_link)
        net = {
            "y": y.tolist(),
            "x": x.tolist(),
            "nodes_at_link": nodes_at_link,
            "topo": topo.tolist(),
            "bedrock": bedrock.tolist(),
            "reach": np.abs(rng.normal(150, 40, n_links)).clip(10).tolist(),
            "width": np.abs(rng.normal(12, 5, n_links)).clip(1).tolist(),
            "depth": np.abs(rng.normal(0.6, 0.3, n_links)).clip(0.02).tolist(),
        }
        n_items = int(rng.integers(1, 15))
        parcels = {
            "links": rng.integers(0, n_links, n_items).tolist(),
            "loc": rng.uniform(0, 1, n_items).tolist(),
            "vol": np.abs(rng.normal(0.4, 0.25, n_items)).clip(0.02).tolist(),
            "D": (rng.choice([0.0015, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15], n_items) * rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5, n_items)).tolist(),
            "rho": rng.uniform(1400, 2650, n_items).tolist(),
            "abr": rng.uniform(0, 2e-4, n_items).tolist(),
        }
        experiment = {
            "dt": float(rng.integers(10, 900)),
            "steps": int(rng.integers(2, 25)),
            "porosity": float(rng.uniform(0.1, 0.5)),
            "rhof": float(rng.uniform(900, 1100)),
            "alm": str(rng.choice(["WongParker", "GrainSizeDependent", "Constant10cm"])),
            "aldm": int(rng.integers(1, 5)),
            "slope_threshold": float(rng.uniform(1e-6, 1e-2)),
            "k_transp_dep_abr": (None if rng.random() < 0.7 else float(rng.uniform(1, 45))),
        }
        configs.append({"net": net, "parcels": parcels, "experiment": experiment})
    cfg_path.write_text(json.dumps(configs))
    print(f"generated {count} configs -> {cfg_path}")
    raise SystemExit(0)

start = int(sys.argv[4])
n = int(sys.argv[5])

configs = json.loads(cfg_path.read_text())
shard = configs[start : start + n]

if mode == "cand":
    sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT))
    from workflow.load_candidate import load_candidate_landlab

    load_candidate_landlab()
    import landlab

    assert ".build" in (landlab.__file__ or "")

sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT / "outputs"))
import fuzz_nst_ref as F

results = []
for cfg in shard:
    net = cfg["net"]
    parcels = {k: np.asarray(v) for k, v in cfg["parcels"].items()}
    try:
        results.append(F.run_one(net, parcels, cfg["experiment"]))
    except Exception as exc:
        results.append({"exception": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"})

out_path = TASK_ROOT / "outputs" / "fuzz" / f"{mode}_{seed}_{count}_{start}_{n}.json"
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(results, allow_nan=True))
print(f"{mode} shard {start}+{n} done -> {out_path}")

17	def gen_network(rng):
18	    n_nodes = int(rng.integers(5, 13))
19	    y = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n_nodes); x = rng.uniform(0, 1000, n_nodes)
20	    gen = np.zeros(n_nodes, dtype=int)
21	    nodes_at_link = []
22	    for k in range(1, n_nodes):
23	        p = int(rng.integers(0, k))
24	        nodes_at_link.append([k, p]); gen[k] = gen[p] + 1
25	    base = rng.uniform(0, 20); step = rng.uniform(0.2, 5.0)
26	    topo = base + (gen.max() - gen) * step + rng.uniform(0, 0.3, n_nodes)
27	    bedrock = topo.copy() if rng.random() < 0.5 else topo - rng.uniform(0, 0.5, n_nodes)
28	    n_links = len(nodes_at_link)
29	    return {"y": y.tolist(), "x": x.tolist(), "nodes_at_link": nodes_at_link,
30	            "topo": topo.tolist(), "bedrock": bedrock.tolist(),
31	            "reach": np.abs(rng.normal(150, 40, n_links)).clip(10).tolist(),
32	            "width": np.abs(rng.normal(12, 5, n_links)).clip(1).tolist(),
33	            "depth": np.abs(rng.normal(0.6, 0.3, n_links)).clip(0.02).tolist()}

59	def run_one(net, parcels, experiment):
60	    grid = NetworkModelGrid((net["y"], net["x"]), net["nodes_at_link"])
61	    grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"] = net["topo"]

67	    n_links = len(net["nodes_at_link"])
68	    dr = make_dr(grid, parcels["links"], parcels)
69	    kwargs = {}
70	    if experiment.get("k_transp_dep_abr") is not None:
71	        kwargs["k_transp_dep_abr"] = experiment["k_transp_dep_abr"]
72	    model = NetworkSedimentTransporter(grid, dr, fd,
73	        bed_porosity=experiment["porosity"], g=9.81, fluid_density=experiment["rhof"],
74	        transport_method=experiment["method"],
75	        active_layer_method=experiment.get("alm", "WongParker"),
76	        active_layer_d_multiplier=experiment.get("aldm", 2),
77	        slope_threshold=float(experiment.get("slope_threshold", 1e-4)), **kwargs)
78	    VARS = ["element_id", "location_in_link", "volume", "D", "active_layer",
79	            "time_arrival_in_link", "starting_link", "abrasion_rate", "density"]
80	    hist = {v: [] for v in VARS}
81	    def snap():
82	        for v in VARS: hist[v].append(np.asarray(dr.dataset[v].values).copy())
83	    snap()
84	    crashed = None
85	    time = 0.0
86	    for step in range(experiment["steps"]):
87	        time += experiment["dt"]
88	        if step in experiment["pulse_steps"]:
89	            pulse_links = experiment["pulse_links"][step]
90	            p = gen_parcels(np.random.default_rng(9000 + step), n_links, len(pulse_links))
91	            sp = SedimentPulserAtLinks(model, parcels=dr,

93	            sp._sediment__total_volume = 0.0

97	            sp(time)
98	        try: model.run_one_step(experiment["dt"])
99	        except Exception as exc:
100	            crashed = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"; break
101	        snap()
102	    out = {v: [np.asarray(a, dtype=float).tolist() for a in hist[v]] for v in VARS}
103	    out["n_items"] = int(dr.number_of_items)
104	    out["times"] = [float(t) for t in dr.dataset.time.values]
105	    out["surface"] = np.asarray(grid.at_node["topographic__elevation"]).tolist()
106	    out["link_fields"] = {k: np.asarray(grid.at_link[k]).tolist() for k in sorted(grid.at_link.keys())}
107	    out["crashed"] = crashed
108	    return out

39	
40	# Summary
41	
42	Coarse sediment (sand, gravel, and cobbles) moves downstream through river networks. The transport rate of any particular sediment grain on the river bed surface is a function of both the hydraulics of that reach of river and the size distribution of the other grains in the reach. As sediment moves through a river system, grains may be deposited or eroded, burying and exposing other grains, and in the process changing the elevation and slope of each segment of river. This process of river channel evolution through the process of sediment transport is referred to as morphodynamics [@ParkerEbook]. Computational morphodynamic models allow for the prediction of sediment pulse transport, such as that which occurs after dam removal [@Cuietal2006a; @Cuietal2006b; @Cui2007a] or landsliding events [@An2017; @Benda&Dunne1997], as well as the prediction of changes in river channel bed surface grain size [@Fergusonetal2015].
43	
44	Most computational morphodynamic models take an Eulerian approach, which tracks changes in bed elevation through time as a function of the spatial gradient in sediment flux [e.g., @ParkerEbook]. These models directly compute bed elevation change and sediment flux throughout the domain. One of the major drawbacks with Eulerian morphodynamic models is the difficulty in being able to 'tag' individual sediment particles to answer questions about how an individual sediment particle/input may move, when it might arrive, and what affect it will have on river morphology when it arrives downstream. To overcome this drawback and to more easily extend morphodynamic models to entire river networks, recent work has focused on developing river-network based Lagrangian sediment transport models, which track the locations of individual sediment units on a river network.
45	
46	A more comprehensive overview of river-network based sediment transport models is described by @Czubaetal2017. Of most relevance to the work described herein, @Czuba2018 introduced a network-based, Lagrangian bed material morphodynamic model that tracks the motion of individual units (referred to as “parcels”) of sediment through a river network. The model presented by @Czuba2018 has been applied to post-wildfire debris-flow sediment movement through a river network in Utah [@Murphyetal2019]. Czuba's approach improves on the existing morphodynamic models by: (1) accounting for the full river network, rather than a single longitudinal profile, (2) allowing the user to ‘tag’ particular sediment inputs and track their fate through time. Despite its advances, this existing network sediment transport model, however, has two notable drawbacks: 1) it written in a proprietary scripting language (MATLAB), and 2) it is not explicitly designed to be interoperable with other Earth-surface models, such as streamflow or landslide models.
47	
48	Here, we present software that overcomes these two drawbacks, translating and expanding upon the network sediment transport model of @Czuba2018 in Landlab, a modular, Python-based package for the modeling of Earth-surface dynamics. Landlab is an open-source Python package for modeling Earth-surface processes [@Hobley2017Creative; @Barnhart2020Short]. It was designed as a modular framework, hosting a variety of process components such as flow routing, hillslope diffusion, and stream power erosion that function on a common set of landscape model grids. The ``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` is the newest of these components. We first describe computational infrastructure built in order to create the ``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` and then describe the new component itself.
49	
50	The creation of the ``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` required the addition of two new data structures in the Landlab framework. First, the ``NetworkModelGrid``, which represents the model domain as connected nodes and links. Second, the ``DataRecord``, which stores a generic set of items in time and on the model grid. It is used here to store all attributes associated with the sediment parcels that move into, through, and out of the model domain.
51	
52	In the ``NetworkSedimentTransporter``, sediment is represented as "parcels"-a quantity of sediment grains with common attributes such as grain diameter, lithology, and density. Each parcel is transported, buried, and eroded as a coherent unit. The river network is represented as a series of links and nodes on a ``NetworkModelGrid``. Each time the ``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` is run forward in time, the set of parcels that are in active transport is identified based on the flow conditions and bed surface grain size in each link, transport distances are calculated for all active parcels based on the @WilcockCrowe2003 equations, and parcels move through links on the network by updating their locations based on their transport distances [@Czuba2018]. As a result of parcel redistribution, the elevation of nodes and slope of the links evolves [@Czubaetal2017; @Czuba2018].
53	
54	Our implementation is not a direct translation of the model implemented in MATLAB and described in @Czuba2018. Here we add three new elements to the model: sediment density that varies across parcels, downstream bed-material abrasion, and enhanced capabilities for specifying the active layer thickness.
55	
56	The use of the ``DataRecord`` attributes to store density and the abrasion-rate coefficient permits different values for each sediment parcel. The density influences which parcels are mobile and how far they move each timestep. Variable (rather than constant) density permits better representing study sites with lithologic variation. Similarly, different rock types may abrade at different rates. The abrasion-rate is calculated as the loss of particle mass (or volume, because density is constant within each parcel) during transport downstream as:
57	
58	$W_x = W_0 \exp \left(\alpha x \right)$
59	
60	Where $x$ is the downstream transport distance, $\alpha$ is the abrasion rate (for mass loss), and $W_x$ and $W_0$ are the resulting and original sediment parcel masses, respectively. The model tracks parcel volumes (not masses) so the actual implementation replaces $W_x$ and $W_0$ with volumes (e.g., $W_0=V_0\rho_s$, where $V_0$ is the original sediment parcel volume and $\rho_s$ is the rock density of the sediment in the parcel); however, the form of the equation for mass or volume is equivalent for a parcel with a constant sediment density (i.e., the $\rho_s$ on both sides of the equation cancel out). Furthermore, once a volume reduction of each parcel is computed, the model also updates the associated reduction in parcel sediment grain size as:
61	
62	$D_x = D_0 \left(\frac{V_x}{V_0}\right)^{1/3}$
63	
64	Where $D_x$ and $D_0$ are the resulting and original sediment parcel diameters, respectively.
65	
66	Our final modification to @Czuba2018 is enhancing the methods used for calculating variable active layer thickness. Many sediment transport models [e.g., @Cui2007b; @Czuba2018] represent the mobile portion of the grains on the riverbed at any given time as an "active layer" of constant thickness. All grains in this layer are transported, whereas all grains below this layer are immobile. Within ``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` the user has the option to specify active layer thickness as a constant value or a multiple of the mean grain size in each link. Alternatively, we incorporated the formulation of @Wongetal2007 to calculate an active layer thickness for each link in the network at each timestep as a function of Shields stress and median grain diameter.
67	
68	The ``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` component of Landlab is capable of routing mixed grain size sediment through river networks to answer questions about how sediment pulses move through river networks and when, where, and how they affect downstream reaches. The accessibility of this code within the Landlab framework will make it easier for future users to modify and contribute to its continual evolution.
69	
70	Source code for ``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` is available as part of the [Landlab Python package](https://github.com/landlab/landlab) and can be found in
71	the [``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` component](https://github.com/landlab/landlab/tree/release/landlab/components/network_sediment_transporter). The first release version of Landlab that includes the ``NetworkSedimentTransporter`` component is tagged as v2.1.0.
72

"""Differential fuzz v3: many scenarios, final-state comparison only.

Usage: python fuzz2.py cand|wheel <seed> <count> <timeout_per_scenario>
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import signal
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

TASK_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MODE = sys.argv[1]
SEED = int(sys.argv[2])
COUNT = int(sys.argv[3])
TO = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 12

if MODE == "cand":
    sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT))
    from workflow.load_candidate import load_candidate_landlab

    load_candidate_landlab()
    import landlab

    assert ".build" in (landlab.__file__ or "")

from landlab.components import FlowDirectorSteepest, NetworkSedimentTransporter
from landlab.data_record import DataRecord
from landlab.grid.network import NetworkModelGrid

sys.path.insert(0, str(TASK_ROOT / "outputs"))
import fuzz_nst_ref as F


def handler(signum, frame):
    raise TimeoutError("scenario-timeout")


signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, handler)

rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
results = []
for i in range(COUNT):
    net = F.gen_network(rng)
    parcels = F.gen_parcels(rng, len(net["nodes_at_link"]))
    experiment = F.gen_experiment(rng)
    # force lighter configs half the time for throughput
    config = F.scrub(net, parcels, experiment)
    signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, TO)
    try:
        out = F.run_one(net, parcels, experiment)
        out = {
            "element_id": out["element_id"][-1] if out["element_id"] else None,
            "location": out["location_in_link"][-1],
            "volume": out["volume"][-1],
            "D": out["D"][-1],
            "active": out["active_layer"][-1],
            "surface": out["surface"],
            "link_fields": out["link_fields"],
            "crashed": out["crashed"],
        }
    except TimeoutError:
        out = {"timeout": True}
    except Exception as exc:
        out = {"exception": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
    finally:
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 0)
    results.append(out)

outdir = TASK_ROOT / "outputs" / "fuzz"
outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(outdir / f"{MODE}_{SEED}_{COUNT}_final.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, allow_nan=True))
print(f"{MODE} {SEED} {COUNT} done")
